author: aniketm99
quote: Weak story, weak characters, weak narrative. Jason is non-existent and Lucia is annoying as hell. People saying it's an RDR sequel not GTA...keep telling yourself that. RDR2 was miles clear of this game. All the critic reviews are paid. And this is not a review bomb, but actual frustration from a GTA enthusiast playing GTA titles since he was 6 years old, dating back to 2005. Utter disappointment after 13 years. I don't even care about the bugs and glitches and stuff. They can be fixed with updates. The story can't be.
